items.title: 68154_Gus Johnson oral history interview
items.q: John Temeeta say, 'You got to go in the Army in Chicago... I didn't let you know about it.'

ctx.x: Well, they knew we were coming to

Tumino said, Chicago. And John Temeeta say, "You got to go in the Army in Chicago, because they have been looking for you and I didn't let you know about it." I said, "Been looking for me?" I know I got a letter saying I was supposed to go to the Army, one of those things. But I didn't know when.
